notes.title: Pizza Slice - Steam Playtest incoming!
notes.content:
Ciao wannabe Pizza Managers!


We’re setting up a limited access, closed playtest for Pizza Slice - our upcoming cozy simulator in which you run a pizza restaurant business. The test is scheduled to last from August 26th until September 16th. To join, simply go to Pizza Slice’s Steam Store Page and click the green “Request Access” button to be viable for participation.



It’s 100% free with the only requirement being able to run the game (that is being above the minimal system requirements). 

Here’s the latest trailer for the game, enjoy![previewyoutube="5d_Os2XN0uk;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr]

🍕About Pizza Slice


If you’ve been dreaming of running an Italian restaurant with traditions right out of a cozy depiction of New York city, then you’re in for a treat! Pizza Slice is more than just a simulator, it is a true Italian adventure! Take on the role of Tonio, manage your family pizzeria, bake authentic Italian pizzas, fight the competition and grow your business. See if you can win the title of the best pizzeria in the area!
Game features:[p align="justify"]• The Dream - Experience a cozy Italy in the heart of a romanticized New York City: run an Italian pizzeria in the middle of a bustling American metropolis. • The Business - owning a restaurant is not only about the food, but also managing ingredients, doing prep work, cleaning, and being the front face of the establishment. In Pizza Slice you need to master the whole business of running a restaurant, not only the food.

• The Buzz - you need to think on your feet - expand the amount of tables, buy better kitchenware, learn or create new recipes, fight your competition and fend off the culinary mafia all while doing your everyday chores. • A cozy simulation - the above points make you sweaty? Relax and have-a-go! Pizza Slice at its heart is a romantic and humorous depiction of what it means to run a modern restaurant business. • A portion for two - you will have your unique staff at the restaurant but why not invite a friend and play together? It’s half the buzz and double the fun! 


[hr][/hr]

🥓What can you expect from the build?


A single player experience, which will showcase the basic gameplay loop: from shopping for ingredients, through prep work, to creating pizzas, serving them and keeping your clientele satisfied. The game will allow you to play for 5 in-game days - enough to get a grasp for the mechanics and the flow of the game, while leaving an appetite for more.



The amount of available ingredients and ways in which you can expand your restaurant and your business will be limited. However, you will still be able to compose your own pizzas and set your own prices for them.



Pizza Slice continues to be in development. The current state of the build does not represent the final quality of the game.


[hr][/hr]

🌿Why are we doing the Playtest?
We strongly believe that modern games should be created alongside the game’s community. We’re looking forward to hearing your feedback about the overall enjoyment of the experience, how well the gameplay loop keeps you interested, and in which direction you would want to see the game expanding.



The playtests will help us find and resolve unforeseen issues and make the game experience tighter. If you have not been selected for this round of tests - don’t worry, you will remain in the pool of possible participants for any future playtests.

Please also bear in mind that this playtest will be a closed one, so no sharing or streaming yet - the game is still in development and not yet in a fully representative state for the general public. Thank you for respecting the embargo.

Build Information & Requirements

Platform: Windows PC via Steam

Controller Support: Partial Support

Supported Languages - VO: English, Text & Interface: ENG, FR, IT, GER, ESP, PL, PT-BR, RUS, PT, Simplified CN.

Hardware Minimum Requirements:

Windows 7 (64-bit) or newer

Intel Core i3, 3,20Ghz / AMD Phenom II X4 955, 3,2Ghz

4 GB RAM

Nvidia GeForce GTX 560 / AMD R7-260x

DirectX 11

6 GB free HDD Space



[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45047327/e00c11da06afea0c97c450539317f9ff2161465d.png"]



[hr][/hr]

🤌How to Join?[olist]
Go to the Pizza Slice Steam Page now. You can follow the link HERE.

Click on the Request Access button found on the playtest section of the page.

That’s it! You’re signed in. Now patiently await for a confirmation email.

The playtests will begin on August 26th, 2025.

The easiest way to ask us questions is by joining our Discord server and asking us directly.

notes.title: Electrician Simulator VR - Available Now!
notes.content:
🚀 Electrician Simulator VR is OUT NOW! ⚡

The wait is over—Electrician Simulator VR is officially LIVE! 🥳🔧 Step into the role of an electrician like never before and experience what it’s like to repair, install, and rewire in a fully immersive VR world.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312719/75f1872e3cf6b06995997749b27f8eb57b0895b6.png

💡 What’s new in Electrician Simulator VR?

🔧 Fully reimagined for VR – Every mission has been redesigned from the ground up to take full advantage of immersive, hands-on gameplay.
⚡ More interactivity – Handle tools, connect wires, and fix electrical issues with precision using intuitive VR controls.
💡 New challenge system – Put your skills to the test with extra tasks that encourage creative problem-solving.
🏠 Explore detailed environments – Work on a variety of jobs, from small repairs to full electrical installations.

💥 Why VR?
Electricity isn’t something you just look at—it’s something you interact with. That’s why Take IT Studio! brought Electrician Simulator to VR! Feel the weight of the tools in your hands, carefully connect wires, and experience the thrill of fixing electrical issues up close. The added immersion makes every job more engaging, whether you’re a seasoned electrician or just learning the ropes.

🛠️ A fresh take on the original experience
If you’ve played Electrician Simulator before, get ready for a completely new approach. While the desktop version was all about precision and strategy, VR takes the experience to another level with real-world interactions, physical problem-solving, and a sense of scale you can’t get on a flat screen. Every mission has been tailored for VR to make sure it feels natural, rewarding, and fun!

So grab your headset, put on your work gloves, and see if you have what it takes to become a pro electrician—or maybe just avoid getting zapped! ⚡ Let us know what you think and share your experiences!

notes.title: Summary of the year
notes.content:
Dear Electricians, 

Today is a special day as we are celebrating the Electrician Simulator anniversary! This is not only an occasion to celebrate, but also a moment to look back at how much we have achieved over the past year. We would like to share with you our successes and updates, both big and small, and thank you for the support we have received from our fantastic community.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/3fee410c4524b0d0ca28ecd1fcf855d4924d2534.jpg

Over the past year, we have been constantly working on improving the game by listening to your feedback and suggestions. Here is what we have managed to do:

 On 21 September, the game was launched with a 20% discount to celebrate reaching 9,000 community members. There was also a stream and a contest.
 The first patch was released in September 2022, tweaking the game and fixing minor bugs.
 A month later, another patch was released, taking into account the community's comments and introducing important fixes and new features. We were also present at PGA 2022, where we had some of the activities prepared for you.
 In November, we fixed bugs, added exciting Halloween missions and add-ons, and introduced Steam Community Items. Electrician Simulator also became on Steam Deck.
 Not much later, we introduced Score the Goal! - football-related content and discounted the game by 30% in the Steam Autumn Sale.
 In December, we added winter content, introduced a roadmap, and refreshed the Steam card.
 Since January, we have been focusing on community feedback and working on new features related to Valentine's Day and the new mode.
 In February we introduced an update with Valentine's Day decor and items.
 March was dedicated to perfecting the new mode that arrived in April - Endless Mode. Meanwhile, we were polishing the Smart Devices DLC.
 In May, Smart Devices DLC was released.
 In June, we ran another contest for our community and participated in the Steam Summer Sale, offering another discount.
We would like to express our immense gratitude to you, our amazing community. Your passion and dedication have been incredibly inspiring to us. It is because of you that Electrician Simulator has become what it is today.

Sale
Finally, don't forget about the ongoing discount on Steam! All discounts are only available until September 25, so if you don't already have Electrician Simulator in your collection, this is the perfect time to get it. Enjoy the game at 50% off and also check out our DLC Smart Devices at 20% off!

Thank you again for this amazing year with you and we can't wait to see what the future holds. We can reveal that we are preparing something exciting for you soon, but more on that later. We wish you amazing gameplay and electrifying fun! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1080020/Electrician_Simulator/ 


See you next time,

Workbench - our biggest problems
Endless Mode seems tailor-made for the workbench. Randomly broken components and parts of items fit perfectly into the gameplay of this type. 

However, in addition to the undoubted advantages of the whole solution, there were also problems that we had to overcome. One of the problems encountered was that we had to adapt each part of the device to break down randomly and fully function after repair.

Now we are not the ones who dictate what players get in the workshop, the fault can occur anywhere!

https://i.imgur.com/5k9cv6X.gif

The most important thing in the new mode
In the course of our work, we encountered many problems and hard choices, which ultimately led us to the moment we are in now. 

A lot of factors are certainly needed to create a good Endless Mode in the game, from programming new malfunctions to preparing new item layouts, to preparing the randomization system. However, in our opinion, one of the most important element is gameplay balance.

Games and reality are two different worlds. Especially when it comes to issues carried out incorrectly, it can seriously harm us. Remember that our game is a simulator that simplifies certain mechanics and you should not repeat the activities of the game at home. Remember that in the real world, it is not possible to load a previous save and go back in time. 

Let's start with what is most important: how it looks in our world. It has been known for a long time that electricity can seriously harm us, so we should always be careful even when replacing a light bulb. 

[previewyoutube=1ZYjP7iybW4;full][/previewyoutube]

In Electrician Simulator, the worst thing that can happen to you is not to execute the order correctly. If your installation does not work, you can always undo the save. Same with the assembly of things, the game will show where you should not mount a given element. And by far the most important difference - if your character is electrocuted, you will not feel it on your own.

Remember that with electricity there is no fun and if there is a problem that you can not solve, then call the Electrician! ;)

notes.title: The most electrifying premiere this autumn!
notes.content:
Dear Electricans!

Release of the Electrician Simulator is September 22nd!

By creating Electrician Simulator, we wanted to redefine the simulator genre. Prove that these games do not have to be boring and repetitive, and can attract with interesting tasks and a crazy world. We listened hard to the players' comments,corrected the inconsistencies found in the prologue version and added a whole bunch of new items and locations.

[previewyoutube=JCfCGs9Ccbg;full][/previewyoutube]

We collected your feedback from the First Shock which we very much appreciated, thank you! By the way we wanted to answer the most popular questions in our community:

1. Will this game be genderless? Can you pick who you would like to play?
We are writing the story elements right now and we’ve heard the players’ feedback. As much as we respect the LGBTQ+ Community, we are unable to incorporate all non-binary options due to limited time before the premiere. This is why we’ve made a decision to use gender-neutral dialogue options.

2. Will there be more electric systems in the game, not only in Europe? US/Asia standards? A menu where the player can select what region, and then use that to show different color schemes, wires types and electric panel?
We have decided to place the whole game in a fictional town in order to be able to explain the differences from the real world. We’ve heard all your feedback and we are currently planning post-release support for the game. Depending on its success, we might be able to introduce DLCs with extra standards.

3. Would it be possible to implement panel wiring such as motor starter panels (Star/Delta, cap-start/cap-run, DOL starters and sequence starters) this platform could be used for more than just fun, it could be used to educate electrician apprentices or people wanting to get into the electrical field?
As much as we would love to expand features and introduce as many appliances and panels as possible, we are not experts in electricity, education nor providing educational software. It is something to look at in the future, depending on the game’s success.

4. Will there be VR?
Not at the moment, however it depends on the game’s commercial success.

5. Is this game gonna be accurate in terms of appliances?
We are trying to introduce as many original appliances in the game as possible, including workbench items and job-related materials. Please keep in mind that this is a game and it’s supposed to be fun - some appliances may differ for gamification reasons (if an appliance is very interesting but complicated, we reduce it a bit so it doesn’t become an issue to complete a task in-game).

6. Will the game support ultrawide monitors?
We are testing available solutions at the moment but are unable to confirm this feature at the moment.

7. Will ES have steam cards and achievements?
Yes.

8. Why does the garage look similar to Phasmophobia?
Because the same asset pack was used for the Prologue. A new garage was created for the full version of the game. The Prologue was a technological demo allowing us to check our ideas against our audience and make decisions that will benefit players. We were focused on mechanics and the joys of gameplay, as well as introducing story elements in a simulator. The garage was effectively a placeholder. And we like Phasmaphobia.

9. Will there be multiplayer?
No.

10. Why is it called a simulator if it is not realistic?
The game is as realistic as it is possible from our perspective. Unfortunately, it is not easy to move all the real-world mechanics into games. Many games with the word “simulator” in their title are not realistic at all. The majority of principles are based on how things work in the real world, many have been changed slightly to simply make the game a game, and to provide a joyful gameplay along with a pleasant experience.

11. What sort of missions will we have that we haven't seen in a demo?
That’s a secret - you need to purchase the game to find out or await official media communications around the release date. We are almost certain that our original approach to this topic shall make everyone happy with the solution to this problem.

12. Will there be proper wire colours in full game as in real life every color has its meaning?
Cable color-coding is specific for different countries and regions, so it is very difficult to provide players from all around the globe gameplay representative for their region. This is why we’ve made a decision to place the whole story in a fictional country in a fictional town with its own standards and coding.

13. Can you delete the timer in the final game or give the option in the menu to turn it off?
The timer has been introduced for the players that enjoy a time-related challenge or speedruns. It does not introduce any bonuses nor penalties, it is there so that players can check themselves against the timer.


See you!

We also work on new workbench items, we add a placement system for light switches, lamps, and electrical devices, but we also let you change some bulbs, which you always really wanted!

notes.title: Devlog #3 - Unique customers
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Another week, another content sneak peek 👀 

Today, we want to show you how we handle some uniqueness in Electrician Simulator. In our game, you will get a lot of tasks from a lot of different customers. How to make their houses look different? How to make sure that players feel the customers' sense of style?

The same, but different?

Let's say people in Electrician Simulator's world buy very similar types of furniture. But it would be kind of boring if all of them look the same. That's why we create many materials variations. Now, every house and every piece of furniture can look unique, even if someone bought it in the same store.

Just look at the compilation below:

https://i.imgur.com/Gtezgfs.gif

As you can see, not only we change furniture colours, but we also modify walls, floors and ceilings. Those changes make rooms even more unique. We can randomize every room appearance. That also means different window setups.

Can you spot all differences? ↓

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/2a70dde1db78cf8f1155a5b10d6a4e0e61fe8c87.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/581474c781e496aba657ba8da67673a97263c381.png

Who would use such blue colours in their house?! Well, non of our business. We can use more discreet colours, and you will still see the difference. The thing is that even with the same furniture given room can be unusual. Of course, it doesn't mean we only use one set of furniture and appliances. But we want to make sure that you will not spot the same place twice.

https://i.imgur.com/3kOkvsM.gif

Anything more?

Yes! We started implementing a new user interface, as you can see below. But wait, what's with all of those weird words?! That's Polish language, meaning we also started working on localizing the game! You will need to wait a little bit longer for all of the languages we support.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/0d87ee469cbe4056fa494d660bbb2fcf6a5496a5.jpg

And that's all this week! We hope that you wait for Electrician Simulator as it encourages us to work faster and better! See you in the next Devlog! Or sooner on our Discord Server:

notes.title: Devlog #2 - Look, interact, repeat
notes.content:
Days are passing by, and we are working on some new content. At the same time, we try to simplify existing game mechanics and tweak them to be fun.

So, what is our main focus right now?

Working on interactions

How to make a game immersive? Well, you have to make sure that many interactions are possible and that those interactions look real. It is not that easy to make an object interactable and to handle both gamepad and mouse/keyboard inputs. Now we are working on electrical sockets. We want to make them fun but also to make them look realistic.

https://i.imgur.com/QirQjv3.gif

It is not final, but we like how smooth working with this socket is. And we want to make it even better! Also, you can see that there are some wires under the socket. Well, we will tell you more about cables in the upcoming devlogs.

So, what else have we got for you?

We are also working on a LOT of 3D assets: sockets, switches, screwdrivers and many, many different tools, which we mainly create from scratch. We want those assets to be unique and very good in terms of quality.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/d41ca758e428f1f871b4aee128bba5c571f9a089.png

And of course, you can interact with items and tools on levels. Our goal is to make many, many different things interactable.

https://i.imgur.com/Xt6Pqof.gif

Another thing we started to work on is the player's laptop. It is the most significant tool in your office. Here you can find all the jobs, look for new supplies in the online shop or even buy some damaged gear and repair it! For now, let's take a look at the computer itself. Later, we will show you how it works.

notes.title: Devlog #1 - *bzzt*
notes.content:
Publisher note:

First, we would like to apologize for a long time you had to wait for any update regarding the Electrician Simulator. We know that these few-months break might make you think we abandoned the project.

Well, we did not!

The reason behind the hiatus -  we were not satisfied with the overall game quality and development progress. For that reason Electrician Simulator has been taken over by Take IT Studio!.

Due to the great interest in the game, we wanted to improve the quality of the game and introduce many new solutions that were not possible before as well.

The game is going to receive regular updates about its progress from now every 2 weeks. We encourage You to become a part of development as we are always open to ideas and feedback.

Now we leave it to Take IT Studio! to share their vision of a game.
Yours, Gaming Factory S.A. Team
---

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/44e08f967d5ffd51a4d992f8f5ab94aa476ed110.png

Hi there!

We are Take IT Studio! and we are pleased to announce that we are new developers of Electrician Simulator! We liked the idea of the project, but we knew it could be developed better. And now we have a chance to prove it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/749e8493f547cbbd61e7c36c295857ac4e6bcc4e.png

What is our idea for Electrician Simulator? Well, we want to make it fun, but not "stupid fun". We want every player to enjoy our game. It does not matter if you are a professional electrician or you know nothing about electricity.

We take care of how the game looks, so details and lightening are significant to us.

Imagine turning on and off nearly all the lights in the house and change the overall mood. Or going down to the black basement using only your flashlight to look for detailed electrician tools. How cool is that?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/e0be2694bf7978f553ade654a10042c25c691271.png

For now, we do not have much to share as the game is undergoing a big graphical overhaul, but we can share a few sneak peeks of the "brand new" Electrician Simulator!

Psst! You can see our first try to make the UI a lot simpler and cleaner down below:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35033617/e8c7277b0089ec6e6d9b079a10c90d1b86741116.png

From now you will read about the game a lot more often. We will update you on the progress of Electrician Simulator and gather your feedback. Feel free to join us on Discord Server and ask anything.

Dorian Loewe
COO of Take IT Studio!
